JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 2) AS net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
SELECT ROUND(SUM(sr_return_amt),2) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 5;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(sr_return_amt),2) FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 5;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number AS tn, ss.ss_item_sk AS ik, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
)
SELECT
  sum(s.net_paid) AS denom_net_paid,
  sum(r.sr_return_amt) AS numer_return_amt,
  round(sum(r.sr_return_amt) / sum(s.net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM s
LEFT JOIN store_returns r
  ON s.tn = r.sr_ticket_number AND s.ik = r.sr_item_sk

WITH s AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number AS tn, ss.ss_item_sk AS ik, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS n_sales_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tn, ik FROM s) t) AS n_distinct_ticket_item,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM s LEFT JOIN store_returns r ON s.tn=r.sr_ticket_number AND s.ik=r.sr_item_sk) AS n_joined,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM s LEFT JOIN store_returns r ON s.tn=r.sr_ticket_number AND s.ik=r.sr_item_sk WHERE r.sr_return_amt IS NOT NULL) AS n_matched_return_rows

SELECT ROUND(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 2) AS net_paid
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE i.i_category = '电子' AND d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9

SELECT ROUND(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 2) AS net_paid
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE i.i_category = '电子' AND d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9

SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy, SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid
FROM store_sales s
JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE (d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9) OR (d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 6)
GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy
ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_moy;

SELECT SUM(s.ss_net_paid) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year=2002 AND d.d_moy=9) - SUM(s.ss_net_paid) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year=2001 AND d.d_moy=6) AS diff FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk;
